findings.issue: The spaces in the jp text were converted to the literal string きごう ('symbol') three times, corrupting the phonetic transcription with extra syllables.
findings.current: わたしわきごうえをきごうかくのがきごうへたです
findings.suggested: わたしわえをかくのがへたです

findings.issue: 四月 (April, the month name) is read しがつ, never よんがつ. The kana teaches a wrong reading of a basic date word.
findings.current: よんがつにこうこうににゅうがくする
findings.suggested: しがつにこうこうににゅうがくする

findings.issue: Token 四 in 四月 (April) must read し, not よん; month names use the on'yomi し (四月＝しがつ).
Same corruption as kana: 'kigou' inserted three times where the jp text has spaces. Not the known punctuation/katakana issue — this is garbage text.
Follows the kana error: 'yongatsu' should be 'shigatsu' (四月 = April).
The whitespace token is given the reading きごう ('symbol'), which is what corrupted kana/romaji. Same defect at tokens[5].r and tokens[9].r. A space has no reading.

どうも is a single indivisible adverb/interjection; it is wrongly split into どう (glossed 'very') + も rendered as a bare null-glossed particle token, teaching a false analysis that も here is the particle も.
findings.suggested: merge どう+も into one token どうも: 'thanks (abbreviated polite thanks)'

findings.issue: In context (靴のひもを…締めた) 締める means 'to tighten/fasten (a lace, belt)'. 'To squeeze, to press' fits another sense and contradicts the pt gloss 'apertar' and both expl fields ('to tighten').
lit_en renders the intransitive 骨が折れました as transitive 'I broke the bone', failing to mirror the JP structure and inconsistent with lit_pt, which correctly mirrors it ('o osso da perna quebrou').
findings.current: I fell and broke the bone in my leg.
findings.suggested: Having fallen, the bone of my leg broke.

findings.issue: Token list contains both null-glossed sub-tokens 大使+館 (tokens[0..1]) AND the full token 大使館 (tokens[2]); the surfaces reconstruct 大使館 twice. Inconsistent with 電話 and with 入学 in other items, which are single tokens.
findings.current: 大使(たいし) + 館(かん) followed by 大使館(たいしかん)
findings.suggested: keep only the single token 大使館; drop the redundant 大使/館 sibling tokens

findings.issue: pt-BR note uses the European-Portuguese (post-AO pt-PT) spelling 'conetiva'; Brazilian Portuguese spells it 'conectiva'.
findings.current: raiz conetiva de する usada antes de ます
findings.suggested: raiz conectiva de する usada antes de ます

findings.issue: lit_en is a plain natural translation showing none of the [noun]+に+する structure, while lit_pt does mirror it ('eu faço (dela a minha escolha)'); the pair is inconsistent and the mirror function is lost.
findings.suggested: As for this red bag, (I) make (it my choice) [にする].
